design.name: 火麒麟·玄鳞
design.brief: Chapter boss, the Fire Qilin (火麒麟) that guards the furnace heart of the fire god's palace, FIRST form 'black-iron scales' (玄鳞): a colossal qilin (麒麟) about 4.5 m tall at the head and 7 m long with real hoofed-animal anatomy and TALL, LONG-LEGGED horse-and-deer proportions (long slender powerful legs with big cloven hooves, a long arched horse-like neck that carries the head high, a deep chest, a lean deer-like body with a tucked waist, an ox-like tail ending in a big tuft) — NOT a lion, NOT a foo dog, NOT stocky or short-legged and a fierce dragon-like head with a broad snout, long whiskers, a lion-like mane of big solid sculpted flame-shaped locks, and ONE long single horn rising from the forehead with a glowing lava-orange fire pearl set at its root (weak spot). Its whole body is armoured in big overlapping scales of black iron (玄铁) edged in dark bronze, with molten lava glowing in the seams between the scales; the mane is deep red and orange; flame-shaped tufts at the elbows and fetlocks like cloud scrolls; the tail tuft is a big solid flame shape. Majestic, ancient and furious.
design.style_note: Stylization: cartoon game proportions in the same family as the desert and frost rosters (jerboa soldier, fire rat, sancai tomb beast, golden snub-nosed monkey): chunky simplified masses, oversized heads and hands or paws, toy-like readable forms with clean bevelled edges. Iron, basalt and bronze as a few big faceted plates with sparse painted wear; lava and fire painted as OPAQUE glowing cracks, seams and solid sculpted flame shapes (never transparent fire, smoke or particles); fur, hair and feathers as a few large carved clumps. Its defence is its own iron scales: it holds NO shield and NO weapon. A boss: grand and iconic, still in the same chunky stylized language.
design.turnaround_lead: Boss model, first form (black-iron scales), neutral bind pose for rigging:
design.turnaround_pose: standing ON ALL FOURS like a real horse or deer (quadruped), body level, the four legs straight and planted, front and hind legs clearly separated with a gap of air between them, belly clear of the ground; the head held up and level facing straight ahead, mouth closed, the single horn pointing up and slightly forward with the pearl at its root painted opaque glowing orange (no halo); the flame mane and tail tuft as solid sculpted shapes, the tail extending backwards and slightly down; the scale seams painted as opaque glowing orange lines (no loose flames, no smoke, no sparks)
design.turnaround_digits: each foot with two cloven hoof toes; the horn tip, the mane, the whiskers and the whole tail fully inside the frame; in the side views the long body and tail must fit inside the view with margin.
design.design_note: DS v001 was stocky and lion-like, too close to the desert sancai tomb beast; v002 asks for tall horse/deer proportions.
